plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Shared machinery every tokenmaxxxer role enables alongside its own rulebook. Owns the issue/PR interaction protocol (contract v3): requirements enter as user-authored issues, every role returns all output as a PR from issue-<n>/<role>, and human decisions are GitHub acts — review Approve opens execution, merge accepts, comment is feedback, close refuses. Gates enforce layout, contract sync, role, branch, ownership, and the propose-first phase.

plugins.name: terse
plugins.description: Output-token compression for every role session: strips conversational filler, code echoes, formatting scaffolding, and repeated summaries from the session's prose while exempting code, worker prompts, frozen contracts, and safety-critical messages. Levels via /terse.
